bio.text: Debbie Buckner represents Georgia House District 137, which includes Talbot County and parts of Meriwether, Muscogee and Troup counties; she was first elected to the General Assembly in 2002.
A native Georgian, Buckner grew up in Columbus and moved to Talbot County in 1976.
Buckner is a former director of community benefit at Columbus Regional Healthcare System and holds a Bachelor of Science in Health Science from Columbus State University.
